findings.text: Browns Friday report lists Judkins questionable after returning limited; its table lists Sampson OUT despite limited Thursday/Friday participation. Practice return is not game availability.

FantasyPros reports Andrews' 21.9% target share and 25.5% first-read share, yet a subdued weekly outlook. Attractive season shares alone do not determine absolute opportunities when pass volume, quarterback and matchup change.
findings.confidence: MEDIUM; underlying dataset not independently audited

educational_lesson.central_method: Separate play probability, conditional volume and allocation instead of automatically distributing an absent teammate's work.
educational_lesson.mathematics: E[targets] = P(active) times E[targets given active] only if inactive targets are zero; within the active state use a joint distribution for team attempts and target share. E[A*S] generally differs from E[A]*E[S] by Cov(A,S).
educational_lesson.synthetic_example: Invented two-state example: equal probabilities of 25 attempts with 30% share or 40 attempts with 15% share give expected targets 6.75. Multiplying mean attempts 32.5 by mean share 22.5% gives 7.3125, overstating by 0.5625. These are not Downs or Andrews projections.
limitations: Injury and game-script scenarios can be correlated.
No fixed Q-tag probability is assigned.
Activation, active status, participation and workload must remain separate variables.

research_proposals.name: Joint game-script/opportunity scenarios improve target distributions
research_proposals.testing_method: Freeze joint-scenario and product-of-means baselines before kickoff; fit only earlier weeks; evaluate held-out target MAE, proper scores and interval coverage, retaining inactive cases. Cluster uncertainty by game.
research_proposals.failure_condition: No adoption if held-out calibration or error does not improve, or gains require postgame scenario selection.
